verses.text: Woe to the bloody city, completely full of lies [and] pillage; [Her] prey never departs.
verses.textZh: 禍哉！這流人血的城，充滿謊詐和強暴，搶奪的事總不止息。

verses.text: The noise of the whip, The noise of the rattling of the wheel, Galloping horses And bounding chariots!
verses.textZh: 鞭聲響亮，車輪轟轟，馬匹踢跳，車輛奔騰，

verses.text: Horsemen charging, Swords flashing, spears gleaming, Many slain, a mass of corpses, And countless dead bodies-- They stumble over the dead bodies!
verses.textZh: 馬兵爭先，刀劍發光，槍矛閃爍，被殺的甚多，屍首成了大堆，屍骸無數，人碰著而跌倒，

verses.text: [All] because of the many harlotries of the harlot, The charming one, the mistress of sorceries, Who sells nations by her harlotries And families by her sorceries.
verses.textZh: 都因那美貌的妓女多有淫行，慣行邪術，藉淫行誘惑列國，用邪術誘惑（原文是賣）多族。

verses.text: 'Behold, I am against you,' declares the LORD of hosts; 'And I will lift up your skirts over your face, And show to the nations your nakedness And to the kingdoms your disgrace.
verses.textZh: 萬軍之耶和華說：我與你為敵；我必揭起你的衣襟，蒙在你臉上，使列國看見你的赤體，使列邦觀看你的醜陋。

verses.text: 'I will throw filth on you And make you vile, And set you up as a spectacle.
verses.textZh: 我必將可憎污穢之物拋在你身上，辱沒你，為眾目所觀。

verses.text: 'And it will come about that all who see you Will shrink from you and say, 'Nineveh is devastated! Who will grieve for her?' Where will I seek comforters for you?'
verses.textZh: 凡看見你的，都必逃跑離開你，說：尼尼微荒涼了！有誰為你悲傷呢？我何處尋得安慰你的人呢？

verses.text: Are you better than No-amon, Which was situated by the waters of the Nile, With water surrounding her, Whose rampart [was] the sea, Whose wall [consisted] of the sea?
verses.textZh: 你豈比挪亞們（或）強呢？挪亞們坐落在眾河之間，周圍有水；海（指尼羅河）作他的濠溝，又作他的城牆。

verses.text: Ethiopia was [her] might, And Egypt too, without limits. Put and Lubim were among her helpers.
verses.textZh: 古實和埃及是他無窮的力量；弗人和路比族是他的幫手。

verses.text: Yet she became an exile, She went into captivity; Also her small children were dashed to pieces At the head of every street; They cast lots for her honorable men, And all her great men were bound with fetters.
verses.textZh: 但他被遷移，被擄去；他的嬰孩在各市口上也被摔死。人為他的尊貴人拈鬮；他所有的大人都被鍊子鎖著。

verses.text: You too will become drunk, You will be hidden. You too will search for a refuge from the enemy.
verses.textZh: 你也必喝醉，必被埋藏，並因仇敵的緣故尋求避難所。

verses.text: All your fortifications are fig trees with ripe fruit-- When shaken, they fall into the eater's mouth.
verses.textZh: 你一切保障必像無花果樹上初熟的無花果，若一搖撼就落在想吃之人的口中。

verses.text: Behold, your people are women in your midst! The gates of your land are opened wide to your enemies; Fire consumes your gate bars.
verses.textZh: 你地上的人民如同婦女；你國中的關口向仇敵敞開；你的門閂被火焚燒。

verses.text: Draw for yourself water for the siege! Strengthen your fortifications! Go into the clay and tread the mortar! Take hold of the brick mold!
verses.textZh: 你要打水預備受困；要堅固你的保障，踹土和泥，修補磚窯。

verses.text: There fire will consume you, The sword will cut you down; It will consume you as the locust [does]. Multiply yourself like the creeping locust, Multiply yourself like the swarming locust.
verses.textZh: 在那裡，火必燒滅你；刀必殺戮你，吞滅你如同蝻子。任你加增人數多如蝻子，多如蝗蟲罷！

verses.text: You have increased your traders more than the stars of heaven-- The creeping locust strips and flies away.
verses.textZh: 你增添商賈，多過天上的星；蝻子吃盡而去。

verses.text: Your guardsmen are like the swarming locust. Your marshals are like hordes of grasshoppers Settling in the stone walls on a cold day. The sun rises and they flee, And the place where they are is not known.
verses.textZh: 你的首領多如蝗蟲；你的軍長彷彿成群的螞蚱，天涼的時候齊落在籬笆上，日頭一出便都飛去，人不知道落在何處。

verses.text: Your shepherds are sleeping, O king of Assyria; Your nobles are lying down. Your people are scattered on the mountains And there is no one to regather [them].
verses.textZh: 亞述王啊，你的牧人睡覺；你的貴冑安歇；你的人民散在山間，無人招聚。

verses.text: There is no relief for your breakdown, Your wound is incurable. All who hear about you Will clap [their] hands over you, For on whom has not your evil passed continually?
verses.textZh: 你的損傷無法醫治；你的傷痕極其重大。凡聽你信息的必都因此向你拍掌。你所行的惡誰沒有時常遭遇呢？
